title: Paired Boolean list chunk
statement: For a Boolean list $s$, let $f$ and $g$ be its paired first- and second-component lists, and let $0_f$ be the zero list associated with $f$. The chunk of $s$ is empty if $g$ is empty; otherwise it is the concatenation of $f$ with two copies of $0_f$.
caveat: The snippet does not define the paired-list or zero-list operations, so their exact constructions cannot be stated here.
